Package com.tonic.analysis.ssa.cfg

Class IRMethod

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.ssa.cfg.IRMethod
  • public class IRMethod
extends Object
    A method in SSA form: its CFG blocks plus parameters, exception handlers, and lowering metadata.
